statement.excerpt: To date, though simulation has proved extremely valuable for all kinds of scientific and engineering applications, as well as video games and in creating CGI for films, it has proven much less effective for commonsense reasoning for AI.
statement.document_title: AI still lacks “common” sense, 70 years later
